title: Payroll System
description:
```
Name        Type        Pay
Alice       Salaried    $5,000.00
Bob         Hourly      $1,240.00 (31h @ $40, 0h overtime)
Cara        Commission  $3,750.00 (base + 5% of $55,000)
Dan         Intern      $800.00
TOTAL                   $10,790.00
```
requirements: Abstract `Employee` with pure virtual `monthlyPay()` and virtual `details()`
Four employee types with their own rules (overtime ×1.5 after 160h)
`Manager` has a `std::vector<Employee*>` team (aggregation) and a bonus per report
